judge.temperature: not settable with claude -p; two runs must agree item by item
judge.systemPrompt: You grade one output from a hospital rounding app against a fixed checklist, using only the text in the user's message. Give your answer only as the structured JSON output; use no other tool.
judge.env: minimal (judgeEnv: basics, proxy/CA, Claude's own variables; no API key)

sources.reading: interim GK8: the visit's completed note (+ earlier entries for U6)

prompt.n6Sentence: N6 accepts either wording: 'Not dictated' or 'Not provided'.
prompt.text:
You are grading one output from a hospital rounding app against a fixed checklist.
You are strict. You give no benefit of the doubt.

SOURCES (the only facts that exist for this patient):
<sources>
THE VISIT'S COMPLETED NOTE:
SUBJECTIVE: Abdomen feels less tight today. Eating better.
OBJECTIVE: BP 108/64, HR 84. Abdomen mildly distended, non-tender. Weight 79.2 kg.
ASSESSMENT AND PLAN: Cirrhosis with ascites, improving. Continue spironolactone 100 mg and furosemide 40 mg daily, 2 g sodium diet. Lactulose to two to three stools daily.

EARLIER TIMELINE ENTRIES (for the dates of earlier facts only):
[1] Oct 11: Admitted with tense ascites
[2] Oct 12: Paracentesis 4 L, tolerated well

TODAY'S DATE:
2026-10-14
</sources>

OUTPUT TO GRADE (course timeline entry, Hospital):
<output>
Oct 14: Alcohol-related cirrhosis with ascites improving post-paracentesis; continuing diuretics and lactulose with dietary sodium restriction
</output>

CHECKLIST:
<checklist>
U1: Every clinical fact (diagnosis, finding, value, drug, dose, date, procedure, severity label) can be traced to a dictation, stored panel, or prior note for this patient.
U2: No diagnosis label, subtype, or cause is added that the source does not state (e.g., "CHF exacerbation" stays as dictated, never "HFrEF"). A label never contradicts its own number ("Na 146" is never "hyponatremia").
U3: Every number matches the source exactly.
U4: No unit is guessed on an ambiguous value (drip rate, lab, threshold). Celsius stays Celsius. A bare weight is never turned into pounds. An oral dose may gain "mg" ("furosemide 40" to "40 mg" is fine).
U5: Every medication's status matches the tracker. A held drug reads held. Nothing is restarted, started, or stopped that the tracker does not show.
U6: A fact from an earlier day appears only with its date ("Cr 1.1 on Oct 1"), never as today's.
U7: Something planned is never written as done ("ablation scheduled" never becomes "s/p ablation").
U8: No placeholders: {ADDRESS}, {PHONE}, [Today's date], [Physician name].
U9: No narration about documentation ("dose not specified in dictation"), and no "No past medical history documented" when PMH simply was not dictated.
T1: The entry states no procedure, start, change, consult, or disposition that the visit's note does not state.
T3: No signature blocks or placeholders in any entry.
T4: Hospital: only today and yesterday appear.
</checklist>

Rules:

- A fact not found in SOURCES is invented, even if clinically likely.
- Grade each item PASS, FAIL, or UNSURE. Use UNSURE when you cannot decide from SOURCES alone.
- For every FAIL, quote the exact output text that breaks the rule, and the exact source text
  it contradicts, or write "no source" if nothing supports it.

- Do not grade style, tone, or length. Only the checklist items.

Return JSON only:
